content_text: You are forgetting that if you select a higher ISO you are underexposing the sensor so there is no loss in highlight information recording ProRes compared to recording raw and underexposing, and then brightening the shot. You bake in noise and color temperature in ProRes Log C but there is no loss in dynamic range.
